description: Queries the total storage size of Huawei Cloud OBS (Object Storage Service) buckets. Prints a single size value, a number in bytes by default; the optional `--unit`/`--human` flags return a scaled (kb/mb/gb) or human-readable value (e.g. `4.77MB`) instead. Supports querying the total size of one bucket or the combined total across all buckets under the account. Uses the KooCLI obsutil-backed `hcloud OBS ls ... -du -bf=raw` command (primary) or the huaweicloudsdkobs Python SDK (fallback). Read-only — never creates, modifies or deletes any resource. On skipped or failed buckets it prints a warning to stderr and continues with the remaining buckets instead of aborting the whole sum. Use this skill whenever the user wants to know the total size of a Huawei Cloud OBS bucket or the overall Huawei Cloud OBS storage usage, e.g. for capacity review, cost estimation or storage planning. Triggers include: OBS total size, OBS bucket size, query OBS storage usage, OBS storage occupied, OBS大小, OBS总大小, OBS桶大小, OBS存储用量, OBS容量, 查询OBS大小.
